Fig. 2: Average jury score vs. average clinician annotation before and after iterative rubric optimization, for clinical safety (left) and clinical accuracy (right) (n = 35). Points are jittered for visibility.

Fig. 1: Overview of IMCBench. Dataset construction: combines public dermatology images (DDI) with synthetic EHRs (Synthea) to form clinically coherent ⟨image, EHR⟩ pairs. Scenario generation: samples clinical tasks and ⟨image, EHR⟩ pairs, along with patient personalities to produce realistic scenarios and initial queries. Conversation simulation: simulates multimodal Patient-Health AI interactions via multi-turn conversations. During Evaluation the conversation is scored by an LLM Jury on three clinical metrics.
